typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsECNSourceSWAPSWIRE_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		KEYWORD_NAME as string,
		KEYWORD_VALUE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromCALYPSODBATRADEKEYWORD
fromCALYPSODBATRADEKEYWORD derive({Copy of KEYWORD_VALUE} = KEYWORD_VALUE,
		{Copy of TRADE_ID} = toString(TRADE_ID),
		{Copy of KEYWORD_NAME} = KEYWORD_NAME) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		KEYWORD_VALUE as string,
		Trade_ID as string,
		KEYWORD_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		KEYWORD_VALUE = {Copy of KEYWORD_VALUE},
		Trade_ID = {Copy of TRADE_ID},
		KEYWORD_NAME = {Copy of KEYWORD_NAME}),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsECNSourceSWAPSWIRE_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblCalypsoMarkitWireExceptionsECNSourceSWAPSWIRE
